pages.title: Keep an Edge
pages.text: Maintain equipment through finite kill- or block-triggered effects.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Warden Vein repairs on kills; Wrought Scale may reduce blocking wear. Coatings have finite charges. Applying one is not proof its actual effect worked.
